en.headline: Video shows rat on counter near utensils at Yuen Long restaurant
en.dek: A clip circulating online late Thursday appears to show a rodent moving along a serving counter with cutlery and drinks in a Yoho Town eatery.
body: A video shared on social media late on Thursday showed what appears to be a rat walking along a counter in a restaurant at Yoho Town in Yuen Long, close to utensils, food containers and drinks.

In the footage, a female staff member is seen handling takeaway orders nearby and does not appear to notice the animal before it jumps to the floor and moves under tables. The poster indicated the location as an eatery at 8 Long Yat Road but did not name the restaurant or confirm the exact time of recording.

The clip has prompted discussion about food hygiene standards. Food and Environmental Hygiene Department inspectors routinely respond to reports of rodent activity in licensed premises, and outlets can face enforcement action if conditions are found to breach licensing requirements.

zh.headline: 元朗YOHO TOWN食肆片段顯老鼠在柜位遊走 近餐具飲品
zh.dek: 周四深夜網上流傳短片，可見一隻老鼠在食肆出菜柜位上移動，附近有餐具及飲品。
body: 一段周四深夜在社交媒體流傳的短片，顯示一隻老鼠在元朗YOHO TOWN一間食肆的柜位上遊走，附近擺放着餐具、食物容器及飲品。
片段中，一名女職員正在處理外賣訂單，似乎未有察覺老鼠，其後老鼠跳落地面並鑽入餐桌底下。上傳者指事發地點為元朗元龍街8號YOHO TOWN內一間食肆，但未有提供店舖名稱或確定拍攝時間。
有關片段引起對食物衛生的關注。食環衛生署對持牌食肆的鼠患投訴會進行跟進，若發現違反發牌條件，可採取執法行動。
